pages.title: The Unbreakable
pages.text: $(bold)The spoils of Legionary's Unbreakable: its cudgel, forgotten bone, gold shards and the thermal stone, with golden chains and lanterns.$(br2)$(thing)Diamond Age$(n), ring 6.$(br)$(thing)23 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Veteran.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill The Unbreakable$(n)$(br2)Pays 5 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
